NBA DFS Picks for Monday, November 16 (DraftKings)

DraftKings main slate · Monday, November 16 · 7 games · First game 7:00 PM ET · By Chris Spags · · Numbers as of November 16, 7:57 PM ET

Giannis Antetokounmpo (MIA) is the top-projected player on the Monday, November 16 DraftKings main slate at 54.0 DraftKings points for $11,700. Alperen Sengun (HOU, 49.9, $9,500) and Jayson Tatum (BOS, 47.6, $10,200) are next.

Cam Spencer (MEM) returns the most per dollar among players projected for at least 20 points: 6.55 projected points per $1,000 at $5,100.

Every projection is a SPAGS model estimate from the November 16, 7:57 PM ET run of the Splash Play NBA model. This page updates each time the main-slate numbers are run, and NBA projections move with every injury report, so check the time above before you build.

How to use these numbers

A projection is a starting point. Salary decides who fits: the Pts/$1K column shows what each player returns for his price. A late scratch changes the minutes and shots of everyone around him, so the numbers from an earlier run can be out of date by the first game.
